question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The manager **asked to the clerk to submit the report**.

options.text: asked the clerk that submit the report
requested the clerk to submit report
asked the clerk to submit the report
told to the clerk submit report

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. asked the clerk to submit the report.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The highlighted part of the sentence contains an incorrect usage of the preposition "to."
 
• The correct structure of the sentence requires the verb "asked" to be directly followed by the object ("the clerk") and the infinitive verb ("to submit").
 
• Therefore, the correct replacement is "asked the clerk to submit the report."

Correct sentence: *The manager asked the clerk to submit the report*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "asked the clerk that submit the report" is grammatically incorrect because "that" cannot be used in this context.
 
• Option 2: "requested the clerk to submit report" is incorrect as "report" should have a definite article ("the report").
 
• Option 4: "told to the clerk submit report" is incorrect because of improper sentence structure and missing articles.
